claim: Original sample: Rahul 300/300 primary labels and Rakesh Ranjan 300/300 second-blinded labels (agreement 269/300 = 89.7%, kappa 0.80); adjudicated accuracy 255/300 = 85.0% (95% CI 80.5%–88.6%); macro F1 0.539

adjudication.adjudicator: Muse (AI-assisted, per labeling guide; human countersignature recommended)

limits: Single 300-record historical sample (29 components, 5 fuel records): validates the broad classifier only; no fuel-specific claim.
Accuracy is not improvement: Phase 2 froze the baseline (no challenger beat it); prospective proof remains the 2027-2030 study.
Adjudication was AI-assisted per the labeling guide with per-decision evidence citations; human countersignature recommended before external claims.
Evaluation-only labels; never for fitting, calibration, feature selection, or dashboard accuracy.
